name: Negated checks do not count (canon clause 1 - affirmative only)
description: Refusal fixtures for the negated-check defect: a prohibitive, negative, conditional-negative or hypothetical phrasing that scopes a check element (thermometer mention, internal temperature, rest statement) must not satisfy any required element. Each case here fails while a linter counts a negated element as a check. Affirmative controls prove the fix does not over-block a correctly worded check, including when a different sentence in the same record is negated.
